messages:
Ava: Quick thought  run a 24-seat Design Partner pilot segmented by mindset: product-builders, infra/ops, and cost-squeezers. purpose: capture different success metrics and avoid one-size-fits-all gating.
Diego: Agree. Keep screener to 3 Qs to tag mindset. target 8 per segment.
Maya: For incentives let's A/B support hours vs credit. want to know what actually drives feedback.
Jordan: Onboarding diverges: product = prompt templates + eval recipe; ops = perf runbook + 1:1; cost = Optimize walkthrough.
Priya: Add a one-line consent for telemetry and pilot terms. I'll draft a checkbox text.
Sam: Ops can support 24 if we stagger waves (8/week). limit 1:1s to 3 hours each.
Ava: Draft success signals: product: 75% complete first integration + 1 feedback session in 14d; ops: perf baseline + infra notes from 30%; cost: >=50% try optimization suggestions with token-cost delta.
Diego: Measurement plan: funnel events + feedback count + nps_30 + qualitative tags (blocker/feature). I'll output a tiny CSV schema.
Maya: Recruitment test: "Ship faster" vs "Cut inference cost" subject lines. A/B and track open->accept.
Jordan: Onboard checklist (short): issue API key, perf smoke test (10 calls) auto-upload, join cohort Slack, schedule feedback session. can we automate smoke test?
Sam: I'll provide a small script for the perf smoke test and reserve ops slots.
dp-bot: Action: create entry in dp-beta-queue, auto-tag segment on screener pass, attach consent link when ready. :robot_face:
